topic.angle: A real moth in a relay, and why the joke worked

card.title: A real moth in a computer

body.claim: Around 1947, operators of the Harvard Mark II computer found a moth stuck in a relay and taped it into their logbook.
body.why: The note called it the 'first actual case of bug being found'. The joke worked because engineers already used 'bug' for technical glitches: Thomas Edison used the word that way in the 1870s. The moth was just a literal one.

probes.question: What was found stuck in the Harvard Mark II's relay in 1947?
True or false: the word 'bug' for a technical glitch was invented in 1947.
